title: Online Chess Kept Growing Long After One TV Show
hook: Online chess reached 200 million members years after the supposed fad.
closing: Entertainment sparked attention, but the online chess habit outlasted the release.
question: What pulled you into chess?

segments.say: Online chess reached 200 million members, showing the boom continued years beyond one television release.
Monthly online chess signups hit 2.8 million after the release, accelerating growth already underway.
Online chess accounts equal about 33% of regular players, leaving the game substantial room to grow.
